2. `_build_kg_skeleton.py` 是否一起改，以及改什么。

138	def log(msg):
139	    line = time.strftime("[%H:%M:%S] ") + str(msg)
140	    try:
141	        print(line, flush=True)
142	    except Exception:
143	        pass
144	    os.makedirs(os.path.join(VLM, "logs"), exist_ok=True)

148	# ---------- PDF 渲染（叠加页码标签） ----------
149	_render_lock = threading.Lock()
150	def render_pages(pdf_path, page_nos, out_dir, dpi=None, tag=""):
151	    """page_nos: 0-based。返回 [图片路径]。文件已存在则复用。多线程安全（全局渲染锁）。"""
152	    with _render_lock:
153	        dpi = dpi or cfg()["dpi"]
154	        os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
155	        doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
156	        out = []
157	        for p in page_nos:
158	            p = max(0, min(p, doc.page_count - 1))
159	            fp = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{tag}_p{p+1}.jpg")
160	            if not os.path.exists(fp):
161	                pg = doc[p]
162	                pix = pg.get_pixmap(dpi=dpi)
163	                pg.insert_text((36, 24), f"PDF p{p+1}", fontsize=14, color=(1, 0, 0))
164	                pix = pg.get_pixmap(dpi=dpi)
165	                pix.save(fp, jpg_quality=80)
166	            out.append(fp)
167	        doc.close()
168	        return out
169	
170	def pdf_toc(pdf_path):
171	    doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
172	    toc = doc.get_toc()   # [[lvl, title, page1based], ...]
173	    n = doc.page_count
174	    doc.close()
175	    return toc, n

177	# ---------- origin 小节切分 ----------
178	BOOKS = {
179	    "数据结构": ("11408/origin/2027数据结构/2027数据结构.md", "11408/pdf/2027数据结构_高清带书签版.pdf"),
180	    "操作系统": ("11408/origin/2027操作系统/2027操作系统.md", "11408/pdf/2027操作系统-高清带书签.pdf"),
181	    "计算机组成原理": ("11408/origin/2027计算机组成原理/2027计算机组成原理.md", "11408/pdf/2027计算机组成原理_高清带书签版.pdf"),

183	}
184	BOOKS = {k: (os.path.join(ROOT, md), os.path.join(ROOT, pdf)) for k, (md, pdf) in BOOKS.items()}

186	def split_sections(md_path, kinds):
187	    """kinds: 'exercise'|'content'。返回 [{sec:'1.2.3', name, kind:'Q'|'A'|'C', text}]"""
188	    lines = open(md_path, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")
189	    heads = []   # (line_idx, sec, name, kind)
190	    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
191	        m = re.match(r"^### (\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\s+(.*)$", l.strip())
192	        if not m:
193	            continue
194	        sec, name = m.group(1), m.group(2).strip()
195	        if re.search(r"(本节试题精选|本节习题精选)", name):
196	            kind = "Q"
197	        elif "答案与解析" in name:
198	            kind = "A"
199	        else:
200	            kind = "C"
201	        heads.append((i, sec, name, kind))
202	    out = []
203	    for k, (i, sec, name, kind) in enumerate(heads):
204	        if kinds == "exercise" and kind not in ("Q", "A"):
205	            continue
206	        if kinds == "content" and kind != "C":
207	            continue
208	        j = heads[k + 1][0] if k + 1 < len(heads) else len(lines)
209	        # 内容节在遇到 ## / # 时也应截断
210	        block = []
211	        for l in lines[i + 1:j]:
212	            if re.match(r"^#{1,2} ", l.strip()):
213	                break
214	            block.append(l)
215	        out.append({"sec": sec, "name": name, "kind": kind, "text": "\n".join(block).strip()})
216	    return out
217	
218	def split_problems(section_text):
219	    """按 ##### NN 标题切成 {num: text}；前言部分挂在前一题(或 'pre')。"""
220	    parts = re.split(r"(?m)^(##### \d{1,2})\s*$", section_text)
221	    probs = {}
222	    pre = parts[0]
223	    for k in range(1, len(parts), 2):
224	        num = parts[k].split()[-1]
225	        body = (parts[k + 1] or "").strip()
226	        probs[num] = body
227	    return probs, pre.strip()
228	
229	def sec_pages(toc, sec):
230	    """从书签找小节页范围（0-based, 含端点）。end=下一个 X.Y.Z 级书签所在页(小节内容可能跨到该页)。
231	    跳过小节内部的题型子书签(如'一、单项选择题')。找不到返回 None。"""
232	    idx = None
233	    for i, (lvl, title, page) in enumerate(toc):
234	        t = title.strip().replace(" ", "").lstrip("*")
235	        if t.startswith(sec):
236	            idx = i
237	            break
238	    if idx is None:
239	        return None
240	    start = toc[idx][2] - 1
241	    end = start
242	    for j in range(idx + 1, len(toc)):
243	        t = toc[j][1].strip().replace(" ", "").lstrip("*")
244	        if re.match(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+", t):   # 下一个节级书签
245	            end = toc[j][2] - 1
246	            break
247	    return start, max(end, start)
